title: 第二十三章 妖兽密林第二十四章 密林深处元婴威压
content_zh:
离开青灵坊市范围，前方是一片广袤无边的黑风密林。
密林连绵数十万里，古木参天，阴气沉沉，是方圆万里之内妖兽聚集最多的区域。林中妖兽种类繁杂，从炼气、凝劲层次的低阶妖兽，到金丹、甚至元婴级别的高阶妖兽，比比皆是。
对于宗门弟子与散修而言，这里既是凶险绝地，也是获取修炼资源的宝地。猎杀妖兽可得妖丹、兽皮，采摘灵草可换取丹药、法器，是中千世界修士磨砺自身、积攒资源的常去之地。
烬孤宸踏入密林，目光平静扫过四周。
参天古木遮蔽天光，林间光线昏暗，风声穿过枝叶，发出呜呜声响。潜藏在暗处的低阶妖兽，嗅到生人气息，纷纷躁动起来。
一头身形半丈的獠牙黑猪率先从草丛中窜出，周身萦绕淡黑色妖气，修为对应凝劲层次，四蹄蹬地，獠牙闪烁寒光，直奔他冲撞而来。
这类低阶妖兽，在凡界堪称凶物，放在中千修真界，却是最底层的存在。
烬孤宸抬手，指尖灵气微吐。
没有繁复招式，仅是一缕金丹灵气弹射而出，精准落在妖兽头颅之上。
砰的一声闷响，獠牙黑猪身躯一僵，轰然倒地，瞬间气绝。
动作简单干脆，杀伐利落，没有丝毫多余动作。他从不刻意玩弄对手，出手便是终结。
继续向前深入密林。
沿途不断有妖兽出没，从通脉、凝劲，再到炼气、筑基层次的妖兽，接连不断发起袭击。
面对阻拦前路的生灵，烬孤宸一律抬手镇压。《万象吞灵诀》悄然运转，妖兽溃散的妖气、散逸的天地灵气，尽数被吸纳体内，转化为自身修为底蕴。
他不刻意搜寻高阶妖兽，也不刻意采摘沿途随处可见的低级灵草。资源只是修行辅助，自身境界与道心，才是根本。
一路前行，一路历练。
肉身在一次次灵气碰撞、近身搏杀中持续打磨，《寂骨锻体诀》与金丹灵气相辅相成，肉身强度稳步提升；神识在密林复杂环境中不断延展、凝练，感知变得愈发敏锐；五行大道、空间大道的基础感悟，也在日复一日的行走与战斗中，渐渐变得深厚。
不知不觉，十日时间过去。
他已深入黑风密林腹地，周遭妖兽的实力明显提升，多数妖兽修为达到筑基层次，更有不少群居妖兽，配合厮杀，凶险倍增。
这一日，前方密林传来阵阵咆哮之声，大地微微震动。

一群身披硬甲的铁鳞巨蟒盘踞在一片灵泉周边，数量足有数十条。为首的一头巨蟒身躯粗如水桶，体长十余丈，鳞甲泛着乌金色光泽，妖气厚重，已然达到金丹中期水准。
灵泉周边灵气浓郁，生长着数株年份不低的淬体灵草，显然是这群巨蟒占据的领地。
察觉到外来者闯入，数十条铁鳞巨蟒同时昂首，猩红的竖瞳锁定烬孤宸，蛇口大张，喷出阵阵腥臭黑雾。
金丹中期的首领巨蟒率先发难，庞大身躯猛地弹射而出，长尾如同钢鞭一般，带着破空之声，狠狠抽击而来。
尾风凌厉，空气都被抽得爆鸣。
周遭其余巨蟒也同时围拢过来，封锁所有退路，妖气交织，形成一片压迫力极强的包围圈。
换做寻常金丹初期修士，面对如此多筑基妖兽加上一头金丹中期妖兽，唯有转身遁逃，稍有不慎便会葬身蟒口。
烬孤宸立于原地，神色没有半点变化。
体内金丹全速转动，周身灵气流转有序。先是踏出《虚空溯影步》，身形在原地分化数道残影，轻易避开巨蟒长尾的重击。
轰隆一声！
巨蟒长尾砸在地面，坚硬的岩石瞬间碎裂，碎石四溅。
趁对方一击落空的间隙，烬孤宸身形突进，双拳接连轰出。
每一拳都凝聚精纯金丹灵气，搭配千锤百炼的肉身之力，拳风厚重霸道。
砰砰砰砰！
连续数拳，精准轰击在数条围上来的筑基层次铁鳞巨蟒七寸要害之处。
content_en:
Leaving the city limits of Qinglingfang, there is a vast and boundless black wind forest ahead.
The dense forest stretches for hundreds of thousands of miles, with towering ancient trees and a gloomy atmosphere. It is an area with the largest concentration of monsters within a radius of thousands of miles. There are many types of monsters in the forest, ranging from low-level monsters at the level of Qi refining and condensing energy, to high-level monsters at the golden elixir and even Nascent Soul level.
For sect disciples and casual cultivators, this place is not only a dangerous place, but also a treasured place to obtain cultivation resources. Hunting monsters can get monster elixirs and animal skins, and picking spiritual grass can be exchanged for elixirs and magic weapons. It is a common place for monks in the Middle Thousand World to hone themselves and accumulate resources.
Jin Guchen stepped into the dense forest, his eyes calmly sweeping around.
Towering ancient trees block the skylight, the light in the forest is dim, and the wind blows through the branches and leaves, making a whining sound. The low-level monsters lurking in the dark became restless when they smelled the scent of strangers.
A half-foot-long tusked black pig took the lead and sprang out from the grass. It was surrounded by a light black demonic aura, and its cultivation level corresponded to the level of concentration. It kicked the ground with its four hooves, its fangs flashed with cold light, and rushed straight towards him.
This kind of low-level monsters can be called dangerous beasts in the mortal world, but in the Zhongqian cultivation world, they are the lowest existence.
Jin Guchen raised his hand and breathed spiritual energy from his fingertips.
There were no complicated moves, just a wisp of golden elixir spiritual energy that shot out and landed accurately on the monster's head.
With a muffled bang, the fanged black pig froze, fell to the ground, and died instantly.
The movements are simple and crisp, and the killing is neat, without any unnecessary movements. He never deliberately plays tricks on his opponents, and his attack is the end.
Continue forward into the dense forest.
There are monsters appearing along the way, ranging from meridians and energy condensers to qi refining and foundation-building monsters, all launching attacks one after another.
Facing the creatures blocking the way forward, Jin Guchen always raised his hand to suppress them. The "All Things Swallowing Spirit Art" operates quietly, and all the demonic energy of the monster beasts and the spiritual energy of heaven and earth are absorbed into the body and transformed into the foundation of one's own cultivation.
He does not deliberately search for high-level monsters, nor does he deliberately pick low-level spiritual grass that can be seen everywhere along the way. Resources are only aids in practice, and one's own realm and Taoist heart are the foundation.
Keep moving forward and experience all the way.
The physical body continues to be polished in repeated collisions of spiritual energy and close combat. The "Silent Bone Body Forging Technique" and the golden elixir spiritual energy complement each other, and the strength of the physical body is steadily improved; the spiritual consciousness continues to extend and condense in the complex environment of the dense forest, and the perception becomes more and more acute; the basic understanding of the Five Elements Avenue and the Space Avenue gradually becomes deeper during walking and fighting day after day.
Before I knew it, ten days had passed.
He has gone deep into the hinterland of the Black Wind Forest, and the strength of the surrounding monsters has increased significantly. Most of the monsters have reached the foundation-building level, and there are many monsters living in groups, fighting together, doubling the danger.
On this day, roars came from the dense forest ahead, and the earth shook slightly.
A group of giant iron-scaled pythons wearing hard armor were entrenched around a spiritual spring. There were dozens of them. The giant python headed by it was as thick as a bucket and more than ten feet long. Its scales glowed with a black-gold luster, and it had a thick demonic aura. It had already reached the middle stage of the golden elixir.
The spiritual energy around the spiritual spring is rich, and there are several old body-tempering spiritual grass growing there, which is obviously the territory occupied by this group of giant pythons.
Sensing the intrusion of outsiders, dozens of giant iron-scaled pythons raised their heads at the same time, locked their scarlet vertical pupils on Jin Guchen, opened their mouths wide, and spewed out bursts of smelly black mist.
The giant python, the leader of the middle stage of the golden elixir, was the first to attack. His huge body suddenly ejected, and its long tail was like a steel whip, with a sound of breaking through the air, and it struck hard.
The tail wind was so fierce that the air was whipped up.
Other giant pythons around him also surrounded him at the same time, blocking all escape routes. The demonic auras intertwined to form an extremely oppressive encirclement.
If you were an ordinary early-stage golden elixir monk, facing so many foundation-building monsters plus a middle-stage golden elixir monster, you would have no choice but to turn around and run away. If you were not careful, you would be killed in the mouth of the python.
Jin Guchen stood on the spot, his expression unchanged at all.
The golden elixir in the body rotates at full speed, and the spiritual energy flows around the bodyOrderly. First, he took the "Void Shadow Retracing Step", and his figure split into several afterimages on the spot, easily avoiding the heavy blow from the giant python's long tail.
Boom!
The giant python's long tail hit the ground, the hard rock shattered instantly, and rubble flew everywhere.
Taking advantage of the gap between the opponent's blows, Jin Guchen rushed forward and punched out with both fists one after another.
Each punch condenses the pure golden elixir spiritual energy, coupled with the strength of the physical body that has been tempered for thousands of times, the punching style is thick and domineering.
Bang bang bang bang!
He punched several times in a row, accurately hitting the seven-inch vital spot of several foundation-level iron-scale giant pythons surrounding him.
